title: Plan
description: A single training plan, exportable/importable on its own (Phase 1/3). Nests the flat rows of templates/training_plan_template.csv by Week -> Day/Session -> exercise entries so the importer/exporter can convert cleanly in both directions.

schema_version.description: Bump on any breaking change to this shape; add a migration step in the importer for each bump. 1 -> 2: a session's single 'assigned_date' became the 'assigned_dates' array (a session can now be scheduled on several dates) - the importer still reads the old singular field from older files.

session.description: One row-group from the template: same Week + Day + Session Name.

day.description: Free text, e.g. "Mon" or "Day 1" for non-date-bound programs.

assigned_dates.description: Every date this session is placed on the calendar; empty while still template-only. A session can be scheduled on several dates at once. Readers should also accept the older singular 'assigned_date' (a nullable date string) from files exported before schema_version 2, treating it as a one-element (or empty) array.

exercise_id.description: Resolved match against schema/exercise.schema.json's id. Null until the import-preview screen resolves it (see exercise_name).

exercise_name.description: Raw name as typed/imported. Kept even after resolution so re-export round-trips the original text.

reps.description: Free text - ranges like "8-10" are common, not just a single number.

weight_intensity.description: Free text - kg/lb, RPE, or %1RM all show up here.
